S1-S2-S5.assessment: Function-call/ref/dynamic forms and HOF/profile controls are mapped. C01-C03 remain the signature/default/option/type evidence, not a new grammar-completeness proof.
S1-S2-S5.remaining: C02 F01-F14 and C03 T01-T05 retain function-specific conversion/options/host limits. Registration count and a passing HOF example do not accept every call contract.

S3-otherwise.assessment: Released ?? preserves empty-versus-present, whole-sequence value, precedence, containing focus and guarded dynamic-error controls. Current draft spells the operator otherwise and is not accepted by either 4.0 profile.
S3-otherwise.remaining: Do not advertise ?? as the pinned normative spelling. Closed-host static binding needs its own review; the public API accepts runtime variable/function context.

S3-keywords.assessment: Reordered/mixed keywords, empty/default, Q{} EQNames and static rejection controls pass. Keyword partial application with ? fails parsing; positional partial application is a working alternative.
S3-keywords.remaining: Per-function metadata and spelling drift remain C02 F01. Dynamic calls have positional argument grammar; their rejection is not evidence of a missing universal keyword facility.

S3-lexical.assessment: Radix/separator token boundaries, template escaping/nesting/comment/atomization and old-profile/static-error cases are mapped. C03 retains numeric representation limits.
S3-lexical.remaining: Do not infer arbitrary precision, every adjacency/Unicode digit case, XML/XQuery string constructors or AVT/host behavior from these lexical probes.

S4-focus.assessment: Pipeline whole-value/fixed-focus, focus-function implicit/explicit signatures, lexical capture/restoration and accepted mapping syntax are mapped. Mapping arrow extra arguments incorrectly see mapped-item focus rather than the containing focus.
S4-focus.remaining: Use for $u in ... return F($u,A...) when extra arguments depend on outer dot/position/size. C03 constructor capture/type coverage remains distinct. Host/profile propagation belongs to C06.

REQ123-scan.assessment: scan is Experimental-only in calls and lookup, with N+1 single-member-array states and empty input retaining the seed. Its existing gate retry is not frozen API promotion.
REQ123-scan.remaining: No new function syntax or frozen promotion. C02 callback semantics and C06 host/profile ownership remain distinct from membership in GatedSets.

G01-otherwise-spelling.status: Unsupported current-draft spelling; explicit adoption decision remains
G01-otherwise-spelling.owner: Bosak parser/catalog maintainer and C13 owner disposition
G01-otherwise-spelling.observed: Bosak accepts ?? and rejects otherwise with XPST0003 in both 4.0 profiles.
G01-otherwise-spelling.exitCriteria: Decide retained ?? compatibility/extension policy and contextual otherwise spelling; preserve element-name use, precedence, guarded errors and lower-profile refusals. Do not claim recovered historical adoption.

G02-mapping-containing-focus.status: Reproduced contextual semantics defect; not fixed
G02-mapping-containing-focus.required: U =!> F(A...) is defined by for $u in U return F($u,A...), preserving containing focus for extra arguments.
G02-mapping-containing-focus.observed: Parser lowers to simple-map U ! F(.,A...), changing dot/position/size in extra arguments.
G02-mapping-containing-focus.exitCriteria: Preserve containing focus while prepending each item, without losing order/multiplicity/empty guards. Add independent named/dynamic/inline target and argument controls plus both engine gates before merging an engine fix.

G03-keyword-placeholders.status: Reproduced unsupported current-draft argument production; not fixed
G03-keyword-placeholders.required: KeywordArgument uses Argument, which includes ArgumentPlaceholder.
G03-keyword-placeholders.observed: substring(value := ?,start := 2,length := 2) fails XPST0003; positional substring(?,2,2) works.
G03-keyword-placeholders.exitCriteria: Recognize placeholders in keyword argument positions and verify resulting arity/default/collision/partial binding semantics in both 4.0 profiles; retain old-profile refusal and run engine gates for an engine correction.

G04-late-binding-boundary.status: Host/static-context review, not a proved closed-context defect
G04-late-binding-boundary.owner: C06 host review and C13 owner disposition
G04-late-binding-boundary.required: Guarding does not waive static errors in a closed static context.
G04-late-binding-boundary.observed: Public API can compile before runtime variables/functions are supplied; standalone unresolved calls/variables error during evaluation, while guarded unselected branches are omitted.
G04-late-binding-boundary.exitCriteria: Review closed XSLT/XQuery/strict-host binding separately. Do not misclassify open API runtime registration as an unknown-static-name failure or assume one error phase across all contexts.

G05-remaining-combinations.owner: C05/C06 and C09-C12 final applicable-evidence review
G05-remaining-combinations.required: Production/semantic/context evidence must match claimed support.
G05-remaining-combinations.observed: Bounded lexical/focus/callback examples do not establish all type, adjacency, Unicode, host or error-eagerness combinations.
G05-remaining-combinations.exitCriteria: Retain existing evidence and accurately bound claims; final entry review and owner acceptance remain required, rather than automatically implementing every draft addition.
